questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne opleve studiekulturen i et andet land, gerne uden for Europa. Derfor søgte jeg i USA og Canada, hvor jeg blev optaget på et canadisk universitet.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer:
Western University har en god administration og folk koblet til udvekslingsstuderende, så ved manglende informationer er der god mulighed for at få hjælp. 
Dertil blev der også holdt informationsmøder inden afgang.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var et obligatorisk intromøde for udvekslingsstuderende, hvor vi blev introduceret til skolen og området.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer:
Western University har en del muligheder for at bo på campus, dog er alle muligheder ikke egnet til udvekslingsstuderende. 
Så der var gode muligheder for at blive tildelt en plads på campus, dog ikke noget der er garanteret.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde køkken i min lejlighed, men det var også muligt at tilkøbe sig en meal plan.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der var reelt set to muligheder for udvekslingsstuderende at bo på campus. Det er en god mulighed for udvekslingsstuderende at bo på campus, fordi du er tættere på studielivet, hvilket jeg ser som en fordel især, hvis man rejser alene.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Alting skulle gøres på samme tid, hvad enten man var efterårs- eller forårsstuderende.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
Jeg kan ikke helt huske processen, men Western University er i et fællesskab med KU, så det hjælper på ansøgningsprocessen. 
I forhold til ansøgning om fag, så skal man byde på fagene med et vis antal point.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Det var muligt at kontakte deres udvekslings"konsulent", samt jeg havde modtaget forskellige informationsbreve.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik de fag jeg gerne ville have, og det er muligt at bytte rundt på fagene, mens man er afsted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Læs informationsbrevene igennem og brug tid på at sætte sig ind i tingene.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det var et passende niveau. Der er noget mere pensum i nogle af de fag jeg havde end det man er vant til fra KU, da der er et specifikt sideantal til antal ECTS-point.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det er mere lig gymnasieundervisning, hvor der i nogle fag bliver lagt vægt på deltagelse i undervisningen, både mødepligt og deltagelse i undervisningen, hvor jeg er mere vant til forelæsninger på KU.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Trusts 
Racial profiling in policing 
Youth criminal law 
International criminal law

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Eventuelt international criminal law, fordi det giver et ekstra aspekt til international law, samt med udviklingen i samfundet er det på nuværende tidspunkt meget relevant.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Transport var inkluderet i deres studiekort, hvorfor det var noget dyrere, men derfor også muligt at kunne tage offentligt transport uden at bekymre sig om noget.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer:
Mad var dyrere end jeg troede, især mejeri-produkter grundet deres struktur omkring landmænd. 
Mobil-abonnement er også noget dyrere end i Danmark

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: De har en masse forskellige klubber på campus. Campus består af flere fakulteter, så der var ikke kun juridiske muligheder.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hvilken slags aktivitet man er med i har nok ikke den største betydning, men mere, at man tilmelder sig en klub, så man kan opleve lidt mere med andre studerende.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag på weekendture rundt i landet og oplev nogle af de turistværdige attraktioner.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det siges at Canada og Danmark kulturmæssigt ligner hinanden en del, hvorfor det nok har været relativt nemt at vænne sig til omgivelserne.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer:
Canadiere er mere åbne end danskere er, så det er meget nemt at komme i kontakt med andre, men det er også på et mere overfladisk niveau. 
Et forslag kunne være at melde sig ind i nogle klubber på campus.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Det var ikke kulturel forskel, der var besværlig, men de er meget mere imødekommende end danskere er, så jeg skulle lige vænne mig til deres hilsner.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Alle var meget villige til at hjælpe, hvis man havde problemer.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Nyd det 
Oplev landet 
Husk varmt tøj om vinteren

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er tale om et mindre universitet med 200-300 studerende, så folk kender hinanden bedre på kryds og tværs.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At møde nye mennesker

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At læse op til eksamen

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
